name: Guelph / North York
description: A Guelph–Georgetown–Brampton–North York local corridor, historically terminating at York Mills and sharing portions with 31.

timeline.event: GO introduced a Georgetown–Brampton–Malton–York Mills corridor, a predecessor of later numbered routes.
Route 33 trip series link Guelph and Georgetown with Yorkdale/York Mills.
The family includes Guelph Central, the University of Guelph and Acton GO.
Hourly weekday off-peak service was added.
Weekend service was added for train connections at Mount Pleasant.

sources.title: 50 Years of GO Transit Bus Operations — historical chronology by Adam Zhelka / Toronto Transportation Society

gaps: The 1976 predecessor does not prove the 33 number was then used.
Guelph/Acton terminal-relocation dates need primary notices.
Weekend short turns should be taken from dated GTFS, not inferred from the full weekday route.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
